verdict.rationale: Salesmate's own docs say it can automate nurture journeys and run campaigns on CRM data, and that it offers email marketing on a dedicated IP. That points to multi-step outbound email from inside the product, but email templates and sales sequences are never named. missing for 10: explicit documentation of email templates, named multi-step sequence/cadence features, per-prospect sending from contact records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: automate nurture journeys, and run campaigns using the same customer data your teams already rely on
Ensure secure and reliable email marketing with a Dedicated IP address exclusively assigned to your business.
automate your end-to-end sales and marketing playbooks
